opening.argument: The presentation is plainly organized around NETGEAR technical support: it shows a branded live-support session and directs viewers to the NETGEAR support site to submit a product-specific help ticket. Viewers can create an account or log in, then choose email, phone, or online chat. Those are ordinary ways to access product assistance, not a deceptive offer or a demand for payment. The described process includes no credential theft or other scam mechanism, and the evidence supports treating this as routine commerce and customer service.

citations.quote: To contact NETGEAR Support and submit a Help ticket, please do the following: 1) Open a web browser and go to my.netgear.com
If you do not have an account, please create an account, otherwise log in with your existing account
Now you can select to contact Support through Email, Phone, or Online chat.
